semantic.concept: Using Multiple Inheritance (MRO / Mixin pattern) allows modularizing monolithic Tk/CustomTkinter app classes into clean, logical files without sacrificing state sharing or direct access to variables.

procedural.method: Decouple login macro, launch logic, and process cleanup operations from credentials/CRUD layer to simplify account services.

failures.error: Artifact path validation errors when specifying ArtifactMetadata on code files outside the brain/ directory.
failures.fix: Do not specify ArtifactMetadata for workspace code files; only use it for actual user-facing markdown artifacts.

optimizations.description: Decomposed main.py, account_manager.py, and test_automation.py into smaller, focused modules.
optimizations.before_metric: 3 HIGH complexity hotspot files exceeding 800+ lines.
optimizations.after_metric: 0 HIGH complexity hotspot files; all files below 700 lines.
